No submitted video, transcript, or gallery images.

impact_evidence: Targets browser-agent debugging and verification alongside normal developer workflow.

leverage_rationale: Typed product search, filtering, cart, coupon, and structural checkout boundaries make shopping-agent collaboration safer and more reliable than DOM scraping.

creativity_rationale: The structural agent-fills/human-checks-out interaction is a memorable, well-targeted pattern for safe commerce delegation.
creativity_evidence: Safety boundary is implemented as product behavior rather than a prompt instruction.

usability_note: The explicit cart boundary and visible activity should support trust; detailed interaction evidence is missing.
advance_reason: Excellent safety-centered commerce fit with a clear WebMCP delta and audience value.

one_line: A club where personal agents submit diverse, private perspectives on big questions.
what_it_does: Collects one answer per participant agent, keeps answers private until reveal, then presents independent anonymous perspectives.
leverage_rationale: WebMCP enables agents carrying distinct user context to retrieve questions and submit answers with privacy and one-submission constraints, but a general agent could reproduce much of the workflow with friction.
leverage_evidence: Personal agents retrieve questions and submit through WebMCP.
Per-owner privacy, deadlines, and one-answer constraints are described.
execution_rationale: The product has a coherent question-to-reveal workflow and the frame sheet shows multiple consistent product states, though no explicit tool-call trace is visible.
execution_evidence: Frame sheet shows a consistent question/results interface and multiple workflow states.
Description specifies draft, publish, deadline, submission, privacy, and reveal stages.
impact_rationale: People interested in difficult societal or personal questions have a credible desire for diverse perspectives rather than generic single-model answers.
impact_evidence: Specific use case of gathering independent perspectives shaped by participants' personal context.
Anonymous reveal and no-voting design fit discovery and reflection.
creativity_rationale: Using many personal agents as distinct perspective-bearers, with asynchronous private answers and a reveal, is a notably original social interaction model.
creativity_evidence: Personal-agent perspective model rather than repeated prompts to one AI.
Independent anonymous reveal without ranking or consensus.
usability_note: The staged flow appears understandable; participation depends on each user having an agent.
red_flags: No explicit tool invocation is visible in the frame evidence.
standouts: Distinct multi-agent perspective and reveal model.
advance_reason: Strong concept and credible social value, with coherent visual evidence.

one_line: An agent-operated kerning workbench that exports corrected font files.
what_it_does: Shows font pairs as images, lets an agent inspect and adjust spacing through WebMCP, supports human edits and self-checks, and exports TTF output.
leverage_rationale: The page exposes image-returning tools for visual judgments that are impractical through generic UI driving; the agent and human share live font state and the agent performs a large, precise batch workflow.
leverage_evidence: Transcript reports eight page tools, 16 calls, image responses, and 51 pairs processed in three minutes.
preview_pairs provides labelled rendered comparisons specifically for the agent, not an existing UI button.
Transcript reports untouched-pair judgment, human edits, verification in real words, and export.
execution_rationale: The video transcript demonstrates a complete, coherent workflow across loading, visual analysis, selective changes, human review, self-checking, and real font export.
execution_evidence: 113-second submitted video with detailed end-to-end transcript.
Transcript reports two fonts, changed and untouched pairs, before/after inspection, and exported font output.
impact_rationale: Type designers face a real large-scale manual kerning burden, and this directly provides useful acceleration while retaining human control.
impact_evidence: Agent handles visual pair review and leaves already-good pairs untouched.
creativity_rationale: Using an agent to make visual typographic judgments from rendered images, rather than numeric heuristics, is unusually original and deeply pursued.
creativity_evidence: Image-based pair evaluation and agent-only preview tool.
Selective changes, human override, and real-word validation form a distinctive interaction model.
usability_note: Human-visible values, hover history, keyboard editing, and export make the agent workflow complementary rather than opaque.
advance_reason: Best-in-packet evidence of WebMCP indispensability and a complete, novel product workflow.

leverage_evidence: Description lists exact position, legal moves, ranked moves, scores, variations, and annotations as WebMCP tools.

impact_evidence: Targets analysis of real games from photos or screens.

one_line: A declarative Chrome extension that adds inspectable WebMCP tools to existing sites.
what_it_does: Records and replays approved workflows through closed-schema adapters, exposing named JSON-schema tools without modifying target sites.
leverage_rationale: It addresses WebMCP adoption itself: agents get structured tools on legacy sites while adapters avoid screenshots, guessed selectors, arbitrary scripts, and wildcard origins.
leverage_evidence: Manifest V3 runtime registers tools through document.modelContext on approved origins.
Closed step vocabulary, validated adapters, ambiguity fail-closed behavior, and confirmation gates are described.
Recorder and Adapter Studio turn real workflows into reusable parameterized tools.
execution_rationale: The architecture, safety constraints, and full-loop claim are unusually detailed and supported by frame sheets, though no transcript is included.
execution_evidence: Public repository and alive demo are reported.
Three submitted frame sheets are listed.
Description covers Store, Studio, recording, runtime replay, health states, controlled inputs, and out-of-page invocation.
impact_rationale: Most existing websites cannot implement native WebMCP immediately; an adoption layer could make structured agent interaction available without requiring site rewrites.
impact_evidence: Explicitly targets legacy sites and a path toward native WebMCP.
Safety and review model supports deployable community adapters.
creativity_rationale: The combination of a recorder, declarative adapter marketplace, closed execution vocabulary, and WebMCP bridge is an ambitious original infrastructure concept.
creativity_evidence: No-modification adoption layer for arbitrary approved sites.
Closed-schema replay and public PR review avoid arbitrary-code adapters.
usability_note: Studio and inspectable adapters are promising, but setup complexity and frame-level usability are not fully established.
red_flags: No transcript or explicit invocation trace.
advance_reason: High-impact infrastructure with a substantial, safety-aware WebMCP delta.
